scope: Definitions for the 28 analyst question families. Four reviewed consumer fact types are enabled; catalogued formulas do not enable new calculation routes.

metrics.name: Reported revenue
metrics.definition: Reported total revenue for the named business and period.
comparison_traps: Preserve GAAP, FTE and managed presentation; consumer segment definitions are bank specific.

BAC: total revenue, net of interest expense
C: total revenues, net of interest expense

metrics.name: Noninterest expense
metrics.definition: Reported noninterest expense for the named business and period.
comparison_traps: Retain notable expense items and segment allocations unless a source-backed reconciliation is requested.

metrics.name: Net interest income
metrics.definition: Reported net interest income, retaining the business scope and reporting basis.
comparison_traps: Segment funding allocations can affect NII; do not infer internal transfer rates.

metrics.name: Noninterest income / revenue
metrics.definition: Reported aggregate noninterest income or revenue.
comparison_traps: Noninterest income is not synonymous with fees; retain gains and other components.

metrics.name: Net income
metrics.definition: Reported net income with the attribution population retained.
comparison_traps: Net income and income available to common shareholders are different measures.

metrics.name: Total assets
metrics.definition: Total assets at a specified reporting date.
comparison_traps: Do not substitute average or interest-earning assets.

metrics.name: Average total assets
metrics.definition: Bank-reported average total assets over the period.
comparison_traps: Period-end balances cannot substitute for period averages.

metrics.name: Return on assets
metrics.definition: Bank-reported return on assets under its disclosed annualization and income conventions.
comparison_traps: ROA is not return on allocated capital.
metrics.numerator: Source-defined attributable income, using disclosed annualization
metrics.denominator: Average total assets under the disclosed convention

metrics.name: Return on tangible common equity
metrics.definition: Bank-reported ROTCE, preserving adjusted or unadjusted presentation.
comparison_traps: Do not subtract a notable dollar amount directly from a percentage; require a reconciliation.
metrics.numerator: Income available to common shareholders, retaining disclosed adjustments and annualization

metrics.name: Net interest margin / net yield
metrics.definition: Reported margin or yield with the bank-specific numerator and interest-earning asset denominator.
comparison_traps: Net yield including Markets and excluding Markets are separate series.
metrics.numerator: Source-defined net interest income with disclosed annualization
metrics.denominator: Source-defined average interest-earning assets, with Markets inclusion retained

metrics.name: NII rate sensitivity
metrics.definition: Disclosed modeled NII response to a specified rate scenario and horizon.
comparison_traps: A common rate shock does not make different bank model assumptions comparable.

metrics.name: NII guidance
metrics.definition: Management guidance identified by issuance date, forecast horizon, range and business scope.
comparison_traps: A guidance change requires both dated versions; do not derive guidance from historical NII.

metrics.name: Deposits
metrics.definition: Reported deposit balance for the specified segment and balance convention.
comparison_traps: Average and period-end deposits must remain separate.

metrics.name: Noninterest-bearing deposits
metrics.definition: Reported deposits bearing no interest for a defined deposit population.
comparison_traps: Use the same population and date for deposit-mix denominators.

metrics.name: Interest-bearing deposit rate
metrics.definition: Reported cost or rate paid on the specified interest-bearing deposit population.
comparison_traps: Do not compare a rate on all deposits with a rate on interest-bearing deposits.
metrics.numerator: Source-defined deposit interest expense with disclosed annualization

metrics.name: Deposit beta
metrics.definition: Deposit-rate change relative to a specified reference-rate change and cycle.
comparison_traps: Cumulative and marginal betas and different rate cycles are distinct.
metrics.formula: Disclosed deposit-rate change / matching benchmark-rate change * 100; not implemented
metrics.numerator: Change in the specified deposit rate over the selected cycle
metrics.denominator: Change in the specified reference rate over the same cycle

metrics.name: Loans
metrics.definition: Reported loan balance with allowance, held-for-sale and balance conventions retained.
comparison_traps: Loans and leases, held-for-investment loans and total loans may differ.

metrics.name: Loan-to-deposit ratio
metrics.definition: Loans divided by deposits under a stated matching balance convention.
comparison_traps: Use consistent dates, populations and gross/net loan conventions.

metrics.name: Credit card net charge-off rate
metrics.definition: Reported annualized NCO rate for the defined card portfolio.
comparison_traps: Card NCO rates cannot substitute for total-loan NCO rates.
metrics.numerator: Source-defined card net charge-offs, with disclosed annualization

metrics.name: Net charge-offs
metrics.definition: Reported net charge-off amount for the defined loan portfolio.
comparison_traps: Keep recoveries, card-only amounts and total-loan amounts distinct.

metrics.name: Provision for credit losses
metrics.definition: Reported provision expense with its covered asset populations.
comparison_traps: Provision can include off-balance-sheet and other credit exposures.

metrics.name: Reserve build / release
metrics.definition: Bank-disclosed reserve build or release and its allowance reconciliation.
comparison_traps: Provision minus NCO need not explain every allowance movement.

metrics.name: Commercial real estate exposure
metrics.definition: Reported CRE exposure under the bank-specific portfolio definition.
comparison_traps: CRE, office CRE and construction exposures have different definitions.

metrics.name: CRE nonperforming loans
metrics.definition: Reported nonperforming loans in the disclosed CRE portfolio.
comparison_traps: Preserve nonperforming/nonaccrual definitions and the same CRE population.

metrics.name: Allowance for credit losses
metrics.definition: Reported allowance for the stated loan and other credit exposure population.
comparison_traps: Loan-only and total credit-loss allowances cannot be interchanged.

metrics.name: Nonperforming loans
metrics.definition: Reported nonperforming loans under the bank-specific definition.
comparison_traps: Nonaccrual and nonperforming populations may differ.

metrics.name: Allowance-to-loans coverage
metrics.definition: Matching loan allowance divided by matching loans.
comparison_traps: Align the allowance and loan populations.
metrics.formula: Matching loan allowance / matching loans * 100; not implemented
metrics.numerator: Loan allowance for the matching portfolio
metrics.denominator: Matching gross/net loan balance as disclosed

metrics.name: Allowance-to-NPL coverage
metrics.definition: Matching allowance divided by matching nonperforming loans.
comparison_traps: Coverage is sensitive to bank-specific NPL definitions.
metrics.formula: Matching allowance / matching NPL * 100; not implemented

metrics.name: CET1 ratio
metrics.definition: Reported CET1 risk-based capital ratio under a named approach.
comparison_traps: CET1, Tier 1 and total capital ratios are separate measures.
metrics.denominator: Risk-weighted assets under the named regulatory approach

metrics.name: Capital requirement
metrics.definition: Disclosed requirement for the named bank, capital measure, approach and effective date.
comparison_traps: A CET1 requirement cannot establish whether total capital is the binding constraint.

metrics.name: Capital buffer
metrics.definition: Reported capital ratio less its matching applicable requirement.
comparison_traps: Do not assume the same binding measure or requirement across banks.
metrics.formula: Matching capital ratio minus matching requirement; not implemented

metrics.name: Share repurchases
metrics.definition: Reported repurchase amount, preserving settlement and authorization conventions.
comparison_traps: An authorization is not an executed repurchase.

metrics.name: Common dividends
metrics.definition: Reported common dividends paid or declared under a named convention.
comparison_traps: Common and preferred dividends are separate.

metrics.name: Total payout ratio
metrics.definition: Reported or reconciled common distributions relative to the stated earnings measure.
comparison_traps: Adjusted and reported earnings produce different payout ratios.
metrics.formula: Matching common dividends plus repurchases, divided by matching earnings * 100; not implemented
metrics.numerator: Matching common distributions: repurchases plus common dividends
metrics.denominator: Matching reported or adjusted earnings as specified

metrics.name: Regulatory change impact
metrics.definition: Dated management estimate tied to a specified proposal or final rule.
comparison_traps: Proposed and final rules and management scenarios must stay distinct.

metrics.name: Efficiency / overhead ratio
metrics.definition: Bank-reported expense-to-revenue ratio with numerator and basis retained.
comparison_traps: GAAP, FTE and managed ratios cannot be silently interchanged.
metrics.denominator: Matching source-defined revenue on the same basis

metrics.name: Operating leverage
metrics.definition: Project definition: revenue YoY growth minus noninterest expense YoY growth.
comparison_traps: This project formula need not equal every bank-defined measure.
metrics.formula: Revenue YoY growth minus noninterest expense YoY growth; implemented for reviewed consumer inputs only

metrics.name: Technology expense
metrics.definition: Disclosed technology expenditure or expense under the source definition.
comparison_traps: Technology investment and recognized expense are not interchangeable.

metrics.name: Headcount
metrics.definition: Disclosed employee count with population and averaging convention retained.
comparison_traps: Period-end employees, average FTEs and contractors may differ.

metrics.name: Consumer segment margin
metrics.definition: A specifically defined segment margin; clarification is required if the numerator or denominator is absent.
comparison_traps: Net interest margin, pretax margin and net income margin are different metrics.
metrics.numerator: Requires analyst clarification: e.g. pretax income, net income or NII
metrics.denominator: Requires analyst clarification: e.g. revenue or earning assets

metrics.name: Investment banking fees
metrics.definition: Reported investment banking fees with product and segment scope retained.
comparison_traps: Advisory, underwriting and total fees can have different coverage.

metrics.name: FICC trading revenue
metrics.definition: Reported fixed income, currencies and commodities or source-defined fixed income trading revenue.
comparison_traps: Product scope and trading adjustments may differ across banks.

metrics.name: Equities trading revenue
metrics.definition: Reported equities trading revenue with product scope retained.
comparison_traps: Do not mix trading revenue with other equity-related income.

metrics.name: Market share
metrics.definition: A named activity divided by its matching independently sourced market total.
comparison_traps: Two banks alone are not the market denominator.
metrics.numerator: Named activity within the stated geography and market definition
metrics.denominator: Matching independently sourced total market activity

metrics.name: Client flows / net new assets
metrics.definition: Reported client flows with the asset population and flow definition retained.
comparison_traps: Net new assets and net flows may not cover the same populations.

metrics.name: Assets under management
metrics.definition: Reported AUM under the stated asset definition.
comparison_traps: AUM, client assets and assets under supervision are different measures.

metrics.name: Noninterest revenue share
metrics.definition: Noninterest income/revenue divided by matching total revenue.
comparison_traps: A noninterest revenue share is not a pure fee share.
metrics.formula: Matching noninterest income / total revenue * 100; not implemented

metrics.name: Card purchase volume
metrics.definition: Reported card purchase volume for the named products.
comparison_traps: Sales volume and purchase volume can differ.

metrics.name: Debit purchase volume
metrics.definition: Reported debit purchase volume for the named products.
comparison_traps: Do not combine debit and credit series without source support.

metrics.name: New card accounts
metrics.definition: Reported newly opened card accounts under the bank definition.
comparison_traps: Account openings and active accounts are different measures.

metrics.name: Card loans
metrics.definition: Reported card loan balance with balance and portfolio conventions retained.
comparison_traps: Average balances and period-end balances are separate series.

metrics.name: Digital active users
metrics.definition: Reported active digital users under the bank activity definition.
comparison_traps: Enrolled and active users and bank activity windows differ.

metrics.name: Mobile active users
metrics.definition: Reported active mobile users under the bank activity definition.
comparison_traps: Mobile users can overlap with digital users; do not add them.

metrics.name: Stock price
metrics.definition: Observed price with timestamp, listing and adjustment convention.
comparison_traps: Current prices cannot be labelled as historical quarter-end prices.

metrics.name: Tangible book value per share
metrics.definition: Bank-reported TBV per common share with reconciliation retained.
comparison_traps: Preserve the bank-specific tangible equity definition.

metrics.name: Price to tangible book
metrics.definition: Dated stock price divided by the selected dated TBV per share.
comparison_traps: A relative valuation observation is not a demonstrated mispricing conclusion.
metrics.formula: Dated price / dated TBV per share; not implemented
metrics.numerator: Stock price at the specified timestamp
metrics.denominator: Selected dated tangible book value per common share

metrics.name: Dividend yield
metrics.definition: Specified annual dividend per share divided by a dated stock price.
comparison_traps: Trailing and indicated forward yields differ.
metrics.formula: Specified annual DPS / dated price * 100; not implemented
metrics.numerator: Specified annual common dividend per share, trailing or indicated forward
metrics.denominator: Stock price at the specified timestamp

metrics.name: Tangible book value growth
metrics.definition: Change in the same tangible book value measure across specified dates.
comparison_traps: Per-share TBV growth differs from total tangible equity growth.
metrics.formula: Matching current / prior TBV minus one, times 100; not implemented
